records.synonyms_note: Heliotropium procumbens Mill. (1768) is a homotypic synonym of accepted Euploca procumbens; Heliotropium cinereum is another synonym in POWO.
records.duplicate_caution: Keep historical Heliotropium as a searchable alias; do not create a second species card or equate with H. curassavicum.
records.handoff: Taxonomy-only evidence; no county-range decision, learner/media installation, or other lane changes.

records.synonyms_note: POWO lists Heliotropium tenellum (Nutt.) Torr. (1853), Lithospermum tenellum Nutt. (1835), and Heliotropium nuttallii House as homotypic synonyms of Euploca tenella.
records.duplicate_caution: Preserve original Heliotropium source spelling and author; accepted Euploca concept should not be duplicated as Heliotropium.
records.handoff: Taxonomy-only evidence; no county-range decision, learner/media installation, or other lane changes.
